editorial.last_message: Completed the iCalendar implementation; unchanged source passes all 467 corrected ICal 3.0.4 cases.
editorial.notes:
Tests-only ICal 3.0.4 regrade of unchanged preserved gpt-6-astra Max ical-py source. The preceding 3.0.3 publication and current grade both score 467/467, without skips or errors. All 460 unaffected outcomes and all seven changed-case outcomes are identical for this source; two renamed cases are explicitly mapped. Three invalid component-free positive fixtures now contain a valid VTIMEZONE or VEVENT. Orphan diagnostics may appear during parse or bounded expand, without requiring todo/journal occurrence output; missing both still fails. The isolated ADD prohibition requires kind/method/component while avoiding the ambiguous unlisted RECURRENCE-ID property metadata value. These changes leave all 28 assembled model inputs and reference code unchanged. The unchanged reference passes 467/467. A combined permitted-policy control changes from 0/7 on prior tests to 7/7; four independent negative controls retain their exact intended failures without schema amplification. Independent author, authority and patch/control reviews checked the correction; root verified sequential pinned-image regrading and preservation. All cases in this bounded suite pass; this does not establish exhaustive RFC conformance. Failure observations are not independent bug counts. Earlier source/transcript/final-claim reviews remain applicable to the unchanged generation; their complete publication payloads and linked audit history remain preserved. The 3.0.3 cancellation/alarm correction remains in force. Original metadata, raw score, source/transcript/session hashes and input/output/cache/reasoning usage are retained. Tool-call accounting is rechecked from preserved evidence; unavailable counts remain unavailable. Reasoning is an output subset and is not charged twice. The retained API-equivalent estimate is not a subscription charge. Regrading makes no model calls and adds no generation cost.

Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.
